notes.title: Overhaul Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone,
It has been a while but I bring you a new Update, which is mostly technical but also brings several graphical and gameplay improvements.

For some time now I've been (really) slowly converting the game from its original engine (GameMaker Studio 1.4) to its newest iteration. That led me to rewrite almost every line of the game's code.

The only downside of this conversion is that the game now only supports a 64-bit operating system. Which is not that unusual these days but still, the original version is a 32-bit application and will stay available as a "beta" branch in the game's properties.

The original version has some bad performance issues I've never been able to solve properly. The engine upgrade by itself provides some improvement but this time I tried to optimize as much as I was able to. Most notably object and effect rendering, island loading/saving, and a better UI drawing system. So getting under the targeted 60 fps should be harder than with the original.

I made a new savegame format which is now just one .sav file instead of several files in one folder, which is better for saving/loading and for Steam Cloud to manage. You can load your existing saves normally. However, if there is some edge-case scenario and the loading is not successful, the original save folder will stay intact and visible in your savegame list.

The most obvious change is the UI graphics. I tried to make it more consistent with its color palette and overall style. Almost everything from HUD to dialogues has been adjusted, mostly just for looks but some, like the crafting screen merged with inventory, for a better user experience.

A new sandbox mode can be selected when creating a new game. This mode is the original game without quests and content blocks tied to them. Enemy number is also based on the number of in-game days and not story progression. When creating the new sandbox game, there are new world generator settings available under the options button.

Despite all the new code and graphics, there is no new content (like items, buildings, and quests) in the game (except the new sandbox mode). This update started more like a technical challenge for me, rather than content expansion, and I tried to improve things that were already there.

I've never really kept track of every change I have made, but still, I've written this changelog for things that you can actually see or try in the game.

GENERAL
Native system cursor independent of the game's framerate
All keyboard and gamepad bindings are reset to default because of changes in the input system
Added ability to turn off tutorial when any guide is displayed
Added new auto-tiling textures for floors and roofs
Added highlight around quest objects when a compass is activated
Adjusted requirements for some buildings and crafting recipes
GAMEPLAY

Raft speed is now increased when outside of island boundaries
Space between islands is slightly smaller
Compass now also shows your raft and your home island (if set)
Raft storage is now opened automatically when rafting instead of pressing a separate key
Added ability to equip and ignite torch on a raft
Fixed player movement speed when moving diagonally with keyboard
Added screen-shake and hurt overlay for hitting and getting hit by enemies
Added footsteps effect for all human characters and animals
Added shake effect for trees, rocks, bushes,... when they got hit by a player
Added first-aid baggage with bandages and medical kits at the start of a new game
Decreased waiting time when fishing
Ability to drop all selected items in inventory at once by the drop button
Ability to destroy water-source object with a pickaxe, when it is really in your way
Floor construction grid is now constrained to 32x32px grid instead of 16 (because of new textures)
SETTINGS

Added option for borderless fullscreen
Added option to change gamepad graphics
Added support for more resolutions (ultra-wide ones might see island loading on the edges)
Added option to disable auto-save after sleeping
Added more positions for the FPS monitor
USER INTERFACE

Crafting is now built into inventory and recipe results are shown above the action buttons
Map has now its tab button instead of settings
Settings moved under the options tab
The character screen is rearranged and a character's name is added
New icons for buildings on the construction screen
Achievements have now a new in-game screen instead of opening Steam overlay
New graphics for outside view pointers (nearest island and enemies)
Added exclamation mark icon for quest items in inventory and buildings on the construction screen
Locked buildings are now shown on the construction screen
Merged character creation screen with new game
Pause screen tabs are now available when any storage is opened
Colors for character visuals are now set by a palette button next to each line
Newly discovered recipes are highlighted until you look at them or use them
All settings are now on one single page (except for controls) instead of separate tabs
Added key and button icons on the control binding screen

If after all these fixes and rewrites you discover a bug, or the game crashes, please tell me in Steam discussions and I'll try to fix it.

Have a lovely day.

- Petr

notes.title: Hotfix v1.0.0.2
notes.content: Fixed bug where saves on the newest version were shown as incompatible.

notes.title: Game Release
notes.content:
Hello everyone,
I am really glad I can finally tell you that the game is fully released. I have play through it several times and fixed all game-breaking bugs I encountered and hopefully caught all of them but you never know.

Anyway, if you experience such bug, I intend to fix or tweak it, but I'm not implementing any new features or major game changes.

I know FI is not the best game and there is a lot that can be improved, but I'm immensely glad I managed to get it to the state it is in now.

I have started the development years ago at high school. Since then I already realized it was too big of a scope for my first "bigger" project. But thanks to that I learned a lot about programming, graphics and game development as a whole which I intend to utilize more in my future projects. (hopefully something smaller :-D)

At the end of this post would like to thank to all who purchased, supported and more importantly to those who played (and will play) my game.

Have a lovely day.

- Peter

notes.title: Pre-release Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone,
It has been over a year since last update and I think the game is finally ready for another.
I've fixed all bugs that I run into and everything, all quests included, should be fine. But I know there is always something to fix.

These are main additions in this update:

All quests are now unlocked.
Crafting recipe list added to inventory
Ingame map, unlocked after first quest
Sounds - ambient, gameplay, UI
Gamepad support
Steam Achievements
Steam Cloud

And obviously a lot of bugfixes

This update is titled as "pre-release" because this is the last bigger update I intend to release. I know the game could be so much better but I've been on this one project so long it is very hard to get something done and at this point I'm just glad it can be played from start to end without any major game or save breaking problems.

The plan for now is to fix bugs you might run into and do some tweaks, but no major changes and hit a full release in a few months.

I'm really glad for what I was able to create knowing I obviously took too much for my first game.

That's all for this announcement and thank you for playing my game.

Have a lovely day.

- Peter

notes.title: Progress Info
notes.content:
Hello,

I know game should have been released yesterday, but it is not done, and I don't know what to say other than that I am incompetent.

I released current state of the game on public branch for those who already own the game and they can try it.

I didn't fully released it because as I tried go trough the story and there is always something new that is broken or broke because I fixed something else.

I don't want to give up as I think I can fix all of this bugs, but I cannot tell how long it could take.

And lastly I think I'm gonna turn the early access back on, because the game is almost finished (except the audio and bugs) and I promised to release it twice already.

Again, I'm sorry. I hope some of you still want to play my game at this point.
Thank you for understanding.

Have a nice day,

- Peter

notes.title: Release Delay
notes.content:
Hello everyone,
I am sorry to say I have to delay the release again. I underestimated number of things that needs to be done and can go wrong; including debugging.

Several major problems came up as I am trying to implement the story elements into the game.

New release date is set on March 28th, 2019.

I am really ashamed and I can see now I have a poor judgement of my abilities. (I know I realised that really "early") Also I still have some spare days off work that I intend to use in this time and finish this damn game already.

There is also quite possible I will open beta branch for game before release for those who'd like to help me with bugfix.

Thank you for reading, waiting and hopefully your understanding.

Have a nice day,

- Peter

notes.title: Release Date
notes.content:
Hello everyone,
Yesterday was the day (10th of February) I said the game would be either finished or I will abandon it. Unfortunately game is not complete yet, but I think I am capable of finishing it soon.

I was able to complete most of gameplay mechanics and the game is playable but I still have to do most of audio, texts for tutorial/quests and rest of  AI.

So the date March 7, 2019 is new and definitive Release date for Faraway Islands.

I hope this release date is better than end of development.

As always thank you for reading this update.

Have a nice day,

- Peter

notes.title: Development Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone,
You might already notice the lack of news on my twitter and that's because for three months now I have new full-time job and therefore a time spent on development is just couple hours a week at best. And it is not possible for me to continue this way with the initial scope of the game.

When I looked at the plan of things still needed to be done it was obvious that I can't finish the game with everything I want in it. Well I might be able to but who knows how long it would take. So I've decided to cut all unnecessary features  like world editor, user created content or multiple game modes and finish features I have already started.

I've also disabled purchase option for the game as the version live on steam is not updated and does not represent the game very well now. I will make it available again before or when the game is fully released.

I have started making Faraway Islands as hobby when I was at school and it is in development for over three years. That is a lot of time for one indie game of this size and at this point I think I should either finish it soon or abandon it. Because of that I'm giving myself a public deadline.

On February 10, 2019 FI will be on steam store for exactly two years and on this day, It will be either available and fully playable game or I will stop it's development. It is hard for me to make this decision but if i won't do it now I could get trapped in its making indefinitely.

For those thinking I took money and run away I can just say that the number of sold copies did not pass 100 and it is far from it, so this scenario is not very logical, and I've never actually withdraw any money from it. 

At last I want to thank everyone who bought the game and to those who support me either here or on my twitter. I really appreciate it and I will do my best to meet the deadline with finished game.

Thank you for reading this update and hopefully for your understanding.

Have a nice day,

- Peter

notes.title: Progress Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone
Since the last game update I've added a lot of new content, including buildings, items, quest system, AI improvements and several bug fixes. But for the past month I'm working on scenario system which will allow me to create a whole story within the in-game editor and hopefully will allow user scenarios in the future. It is not as easy as I thought so that's another delay which was not planned.

Release Delay
In the early access description I've said that the game will be released in 2017 but because of several large delays, job or family related, it won't be possible. I have to admit I did a really poor job with my development plan, and I can't deny there was a little bit of my laziness and depression time involved in the process.

Future Updates
As I'm adding new content I'm also changing some parts of a code for building, hud, inventory and most importantly loading system for scenarios. Because of that It is hard to constantly think about being able to export a game update without new errors so I most likely won't release any game update on steam until beta or some stable functional version.

Requirements Changes
I know the game does not have the best optimisation and I want to increase the performance over time but I realised it won't be as optimised as I thought when I created first system requirements. Game is not super easy on CPU and I'm not sure about Windows XP either so I'm gonna rewrite it soon.

I really hope this news are ok with you and that there are still people who are looking for playing final product. I'm glad for your support.

Until the next update, I wish everyone a great time and a lot of nice gaming experience.

- Peter

notes.title: Update 0.0.1.5 - Character Creator
notes.content:
Hello everyone,
In this update I finally managed to implement character customisation. There were several complications, like character animations, which I had to resolve, but it's complete now. Character creator will show up when you hit "NEXT" in new game menu.

I also figured out how yyc compiler works and was able to improve game performance with it. This will be very useful when I start working on new AI system later. (yyc compiler is an "tool" for gamemaker studio engine)

That’s all for this update, complete list of new features, tweaks and bugfixes below:

Added

Character customisation
Character's name and gender symbol above character menu
Game over text translation to Czech

Removed

Hand shadow in water
Dying animations

Changes and fixes

Hammer icon was changed from old stone look to iron look
You can see second hand when torch is equipped
Game is now exported with YYC Compiler
Bow and sligshot animations weren't drawing the last image
Game over text scaling

notes.title: Update 0.0.1.4 - 4K support
notes.content:
Hello everyone
First, I must apologise for the lack of news for the game. Like I said in discussion I had some personal problems to resolve and I found a new job, so my development time was reduced. 

Most of the time I was working on Editor and adjusted saving mechanism. Editor is still not finished but looks promising and I hope I will be able to create a story scenario.

Saving code had to be changed a little (for compatibility with editor and future updating) so all older saves will not work anymore.
	
Lot of interface graphics were tweaked or completely changed, like background, buttons, icons, etc... Most obvious changes were made for character page, which was rearranged to be more consistent. HUD was also tweaked: all bars are now reversed (full = good / empty = bad) and I added small icons next to them indicating what is bar showing and its state with colours (green/orange/red).

New resolutions for widescreen and 4K were added to settings. I don’t have a 4K or ultrawide monitor but there shouldn’t be any performance problems with it.

I already teased character creator on twitter, it is mostly finished but there are some problems with hand animations, so I’ve decided to not include it in this update, but it should be in a next one.

That’s all for this update, complete list of new features, tweaks and bugfixes below:

Added

Icons to HUD, representing health/hunger/thirst/fatigue
Sound for moving setting sliders
Switching buttons added to setting sliders
4K support (3840x2160)
Widescreen support (2560x1080, 3440x1440)

Removed

1024x600 resolution

Changes and fixes

HUD bars are now bigger and reversed (full = good / empty = bad)
HUD background renewed
Improved visibility of daylight bar
Renewed whole character page
New hand icon in inventory
Lot of tweaks and improvements of UI buttons, backgrounds, etc.
Grid for planting tree had wrong size
Inputbox selections has now green colour
Control helper not showing "no grid mode" key when building
Inputbox text is no longer visible above info-window layer
Wrong light surface resizing after resolution change
Effect timer was counting even if game was paused
Chest making opening sound if even if not complete

notes.title: Update 0.0.1.3 - Sounds
notes.content:
Hello everyone
In this update I finished sound system and planting, added some new items like more types of arrow and fixed several bugs.

With complete sound system, sounds like footsteps and button clicks were added and more will be implemented in next updates.

In next update I will have to change parts of game saving code so old save files (0.0.1.3 and below) won't be functional anymore.

Complete list of new features, tweaks and bugfixes below:

Added

Footstep sound on grass, sand, wood, dirt and water
Hit sound for rock and iron plate
Slingshot sound
Second HUD slot for ammunition (arrows, pebbles, …)
More arrows (stick, flint, iron) that differs by accuracy
Arrows and other items in second slot can be switched with 'X' by default
Switching key 'X' in keyboard setting
Sapling for planting trees
Chance of dropping sapling from trees
Cottonseed for planting cotton
Chance of dropping cottonseed from when harvesting it
Sounds to all buttons in menu
Field is now build through building menu, not with hoe (old field will still be loaded but can be only destroyed by hoe and can't be planted again)
Collect sound for items on ground, berries and cotton
Spade durability decrease when digging
Sound for typing in inputboxes
Sound for opening and closing door and chest
Sound for destroying  objects and buildings by hammer
Sound for water splash when fishing

Removed

Ability to equip berries and wheat
Ability to craft scythe (will be removed completely with future updates)
Creating fields with hoe
Defense and Misc group from building menu

Changes and fixes

New drinking sound
Switched sides of hotkey number and amount number drawn on inventory slots
Cotton item image has been changed
Bushes image and collision mask were improved
Cotton plant collision mask is slightly larger
Moving sticks or other burnable items to firepit/furnace with Shift key, did not add fuel to it
Ignite button in furnace interface was slightly transparent when highlighted by cursor

notes.content:
Hello everyone,
In this update I allowed steam screenshot and added daytime bar to hud so you now what time of the day it is. Then some bugfixes, saving improvements and changes to furnace functionality.

Taking a screenshots can cause a frame drop but I'm still trying to optimise it.
(when fps drops and stays at 30 it can be repaired by going to desktop and back to the game)

Added

Steam screenshots
Impossibility to load savefile from newer version of the game
Daytime bar to HUD
Proper progress simulation for campfire, firepit and furnaces after sleep
Preview image on slots (input, output, fuel) for campfire, firepit and furnaces

Removed

Chest opening and closing sound (will be added with audio system completion)

Changes and fixes

Chest remained open after unknown circumstances
Temporary island files were not deleted after saving and loading world
Some old systems like "chunk control" are turned off now for better performance
Improved terrain saving
Collision mask for rocks is 1 pixel smaller
Collision mask for trees had wrong shape
Fire on burning tree was drawn under tree
Furnaces fueling system is now the same as for campfire and firepit

notes.title: Update 0.0.1.1 - Welcome
notes.content:
Hello everyone,
In this first update I've added welcome text to main menu with information that the game currently has no tutorial and where to find temporary Steam guide. The game is also pausable now, so your character won't starve when you are away. Other changes, tweaks and improvements are listed below.

Added
 
  Pause is added to all ingame menus like inventory and character
  Option to turn off raindrop waves in graphic settings
  Welcome text in menu with reference to online guide
 
Changes & Fixes
 
  Improvements in saving and loading islands
  Key for diary (J) was functional even with diary locked
  Minimal size of first island is increased from 40*32 to 50*32
  Number of islands increased from 9 to 25
  Night is slightly brighter
  Less number of raindrops
  Chat accepted 24 messages and was returning undefined after it
  Fullscreen is set as default (it runs better)
  Roof was drawn above trees
  You could walk on raft that was not yet placed on water
